TWELVE EARLY VOTING SITES OPERATED FOR 16 DAYS THROUGH ELECTION DAY. THREE SITES WERE AT BRANCH LOCATIONS OF THE SUPERVISOR OF ELECTIONS. ONE ADDITIONAL EARLY VOTING SITE WAS PROVIDED ONLY ON ELECTION DAY FROM 7:00 AM UNTIL 7:00 PM IN BOCA GRANDE, FL. THREE SUPERVISOR OF ELECTIONS OFFICES OFFERED EARLY VOTING AND ABSENTEE BALLOT PICKUP/VOTING. THE SUPERVISOR OF ELECTIONS MAIN OFFICE WAS NOT A DESIGNATED EARLY VOTING SITE BUT OFFERED ABSENTEE BALLOT PICKUP/VOTING AND THEREFORE IS REPORTED IN D3A.
